notes.title: Ayre Update 1.3.5
notes.notes:
Ayre 1.3.5 Minor Update

[list]
[*] Fixed UI for 16:10 aspect ration (AKA the Steamdeck patch)
[*] Increased petting distance so you don't need to be as close to pet the dragon
[/list]

notes.title: Ayre Version 1.2.6
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed first-person camera zoom so the look sensitivity lowers as you zoom in​
[*] Fixed Map not displaying icons properly
[*] Added wings for gliding!  Try dismounting in mid-air!
[*] Added option to turn off low poly clouds 
[*] Added save game backup and fixes for corrupt saves
[*] Added more language support and Google-translated Chinese & Japanese for testing
[*] Dragon now circles down when you jump off
[*] Added glide tutorials
[*] Added new sphere tutorial to let you know you can reset sphere puzzles
[*] Fixed switches in menu not starting in the correct spots
[/list]

notes.title: Ayre Version 1.2.3
notes.notes:
[b]Ayre has been updated to version 1.2.3[/b]

[b]New: [/b]
[list]
[*] Find and complete all 15 sphere puzzles!
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Many Performance Optimizations
[*] Fixed intro post-processing 
[*] Fixed waterfall sounds
[*] Tweaked post-processing values
[*] Changed water to be less performance intensive
[*] Updated languages
[*] Removed keyboard sensitivity which never worked properly
[*] Removed pose buttons from photo mode while on dragon or flying 
[*] Dragon stops hovering if you jump off in the air
[*] Changed default quality to ultra
[/list]

notes.title: Ayre Version 1.2.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704506/4b704a979b177872b86184be856781f900435a29.png[/img]

[h1]A new type of puzzle has been uncovered![/h1]

Find locations more easily with a new compass that shows nearby points of interest.  Complete sphere puzzles to unlock compass abilities.

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Hover mode!
[*]Main Menu - Load now shows savegame file version
[*]Map - New Player icon
[*]Compass - Now shows nearby gems, history markers, armour locations, and ring races when upgraded by completing sphere puzzles.
[*]5 new puzzle shrines where you need to drop a sphere into a target (More shrines coming in later update!)
[*]New Tutorial Popups
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704506/d82ab6954318f92e3f0d9387a4cc78251aacb3eb.png[/img]

[h2]New Default Controls:[/h2]
[list]
[*]H - Enter and Exit hover mode while flying
[*]G- Grab a sphere when close enough
[*]R / F Rise and fall while hovering
[*]T / Y Slide left and right while hovering
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*]New English text has not been translated yet, so other languages have placeholder "google translated" text.  Waiting for translations and will add in a new patch.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704506/4a370ddd6c0c3874ff6c4053e6cc24f119683a2b.png[/img]

[b]Ayre has been updated to version 1.1.1 and brings along the following enhancements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Many performance increases
[*] New dynamic weather skybox (distant clouds)
[*] New Volumetric lighting
[*] New Time of Day system 
[*] New photo mode enhancements

[*] Hide the lowpoly clouds
[/list]
